files.description:
Walking through a bazaar or open market in Turkey. Sounds of customers and sellers shouting to sell their goods.

Recorded using a Zoom H1n portable recorder 24bit 96kHz WAV and Roland CS-10EM binaural in-ear mics.
files.author: tomhannen

files.freesoundName: Istanbul Spice Bazaar (aka Egyptian Bazaar) ambience
files.description:
I recently have been to Istanbul (once again) and have recorded this ambience with my Zoom H4n recorder just by walking inside this old and unique spice market, which exist from at least XVII century.

http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spice_Bazaar,_Istanbul

Recorded May 15, 2015
files.author: tagirov

Building market stalls at 70 metres. Crates and boxes of goods are unloaded and placed on the stalls. You can hear the peddlers talking to each other.

Recorded along small inner-city harbour / marina.
